title: How SoftBank's American House of Cards Collapsed
主要内容: Katerra Inc., a U.S. construction startup, filed for bankruptcy three months after Greensill Capital’s collapse. The firm relied heavily on Greensill for financing, and Greensill’s insolvency led to Katerra’s downfall. The collapse of both firms has cost SoftBank investors about $4 billion. Credit Suisse Group AG has cut ties with SoftBank and is considering suing the Japanese company to recover $440 million in client funds lent to Katerra by Greensill.
